# Eight lessons — Weeks15–16
The optional practice adds no project work. Allow approximately 50–55 minutes per lesson; adjust to the school calendar and access arrangements.

Week 15 L1: 5 minutes of retrieval, 15 on current instructions, commands and source use, 20 on short responses and tracing, and 10–15 on a pacing plan. L2: Set A, 50 minutes (5 reading, 40 working, 5 checking); use remaining time to record uncertainty. L3: compare criteria and explained corrections; model one common cause, then use targeted independent practice. L4: select R1/R3/R4/R5 retries from identified gaps and record evidence and a short revision plan.

Week 16 L1: Set B, 50 minutes, attempted independently. L2: explain and repair errors; distinguish different set content from evidence of improvement. L3: mixed transfer R6 plus a later retry of a priority and brief teacher feedback. L4: short delayed retrieval, readiness/evidence planning and checks of current sources, materials and access arrangements. Do not compress a full-length mock into one lesson.

Sets A and B are original lesson-size practice sets with shorter and longer responses. They are openly available learning resources rather than official papers or predictions. Any school decision to hold full three-hour practice needs a separate authorised calendar allocation replacing other time; this chapter does not add it. School examinations use the school's allocated period; verify the external timetable and rules separately.

References: the 2026 front cover for the current format, the 2025 candidate report for historical advice, and the current course page. Link official past papers and keys rather than republishing protected questions. Explained answers and reference files are openly downloadable for self-review. Review diagrams, legal source currency and actual learner work.
